description: This file defines JSON serialization and deserialization handlers for various types such as integers, booleans, doubles, strings, custom SUB types, and ovs_uuid_t within a software project. It provides functions to convert these data types to and from JSON representations, facilitating data exchange in a JSON format.

methods.name: bool pjs_int_t_from_json(void * data,int idx,json_t * jsdata)
methods.description: Converts a JSON integer to a C integer, storing the result in the provided data array at the specified index.

methods.name: json_t * pjs_int_t_to_json(void * data,int idx)
methods.description: Converts a C integer from the provided data array at the specified index to a JSON integer.

methods.name: bool pjs_bool_t_from_json(void * data,int idx,json_t * jsdata)
methods.description: Converts a JSON boolean to a C boolean, storing the result in the provided data array at the specified index.

methods.name: json_t * pjs_bool_t_to_json(void * data,int idx)
methods.description: Converts a C boolean from the data array at the specified index to a JSON boolean.

methods.name: bool pjs_real_t_from_json(void * data,int idx,json_t * jsdata)
methods.description: Converts a JSON number to a C double, storing the result in the provided data array at the specified index.

methods.name: json_t * pjs_real_t_to_json(void * data,int idx)
methods.description: Converts a C double from the data array at the specified index to a JSON real number.

methods.name: bool pjs_string_t_from_json(void * data,int idx,json_t * jsdata)
methods.description: Converts a JSON string to a C string, storing it in the provided pjs_string_args structure at the specified index.

methods.name: json_t * pjs_string_t_to_json(void * data,int idx)
methods.description: Converts a C string stored in the pjs_string_args structure at the specified index to a JSON string.

methods.name: bool pjs_sub_t_from_json(void * data,int idx,json_t * jsdata)
methods.description: Converts a JSON value to a SUB data type, storing it in the provided args structure at the specified index.

methods.name: json_t * pjs_sub_t_to_json(void * data,int idx)
methods.description: Converts a SUB data type stored in the provided args structure at the specified index to a JSON value.

methods.name: bool pjs_ovs_uuid_t_from_json(void * __data,int idx,json_t * jsdata)
methods.description: Converts a JSON array representing an ovs_uuid_t from JSON to C structure.

methods.name: json_t * pjs_ovs_uuid_t_to_json(void * __data,int idx)
methods.description: Converts an ovs_uuid_t from C structure to a JSON array representation.
